headline: FIRST WEEKLY GAIN SINCE MAY — GOLD UP 2.3%, SILVER SURGES 6.7% AS FED RATE-HIKE BETS EVAPORATE INTO JULY 4 WEEKEND
snippet: Gold touched $4,183 on July 3, 2026 — its highest level since June 23 and on track for a 2.3% weekly gain, snapping four consecutive down weeks and recording the first weekly advance since late May — as the June payrolls shock (57,000 vs. 110,000 consensus) collapsed Fed rate-hike probability below 50% and triggered a broad metals rally. Silver outpaced gold sharply, surging 6.7% on the week to $62.77/oz; OCBC strategists shifted tone from 'cautious' to 'cautiously constructive,' noting that continued soft data could cap real yields and the U.S. dollar heading into Q3.

headline: MAJOR NEW GOLD DISCOVERY IN NEVADA WALKER LANE — VIVA GOLD DRILLS 38.1m AT 0.89 g/t INCL. 6.1m AT 3.56 g/t AU IN MAIDEN MIDWAY HILLS ZONE (TSXV:VAU)
source_name: Investing News Network / Viva Gold Corp. (TSXV:VAU)
snippet: Viva Gold Corp. (TSXV:VAU) reported July 1, 2026 a major new gold-silver discovery at the Midway Hills target — 1,400 metres northwest of the main Tonopah resource pit in Nevada's Walker Lane Mineral Trend — with drill hole TG2616 returning 38.1 metres at 0.89 g/t gold and 6.78 g/t silver, including 6.1 metres at 3.56 g/t gold and 22.45 g/t silver from 179.8 metres depth, entirely within Ordovician Palmetto Argillite host rock. The Midway Hills discovery lies within the existing Exploration Plan of Operations — permitting accelerated follow-up drilling — at a project 30 minutes south of Kinross Gold's Round Mountain Mine; a Pre-Feasibility Study is underway with the final report due Q4 2026.

headline: CATL'S JIANXIAWO MINE RESTARTS AFTER 11-MONTH SHUTDOWN — 100,000-TONNE/YEAR LITHIUM FACILITY ADDS 45K TONNES NEW SUPPLY IN H2 2026
snippet: CATL secured the safety production permit for its Jianxiawo lithium mine in Jiangxi Province on June 29, 2026 and restarted operations July 1, ending an 11-month suspension after the original mining permit expired in August 2025. The mine carries 100,000 tonnes of annual lithium carbonate capacity — representing 8-10% of China's total lithium carbonate output before its shutdown — and analysts expect it to contribute over 45,000 tonnes of incremental LCE in H2 2026 alone, easing upstream supply pressure across the lithium battery chain while capping near-term price upside; Chinese lithium carbonate futures on the GFE swung sharply around the announcement, jumping 8.36% on June 30 before settling as traders processed the supply implications.

headline: 9.19 g/t GOLD AND 5.55% COPPER AT DEPTH VECTORS TOWARD PORPHYRY — ORVANA DRILLS 2,174m IN TWO DEEP HOLES AT TAGUAS, ARGENTINA (TSX:ORV)
snippet: Orvana Minerals Corp. (TSX:ORV) released full assay results from its 2026 deep drilling program at the Taguas Project in Argentina, with hole TADD-279 returning a highlight interval of 1.25 metres at 9.19 g/t gold and 5.55% copper, and a broad composite of 205 metres averaging 0.25 g/t gold and 0.12% copper across the wider mineralised system. The company's exploration director noted that sericitic alteration at depth is consistent with vectoring toward the core of a hydrothermal system potentially linked to a deeper porphyry copper-gold source — significantly expanding the Taguas target model beyond the near-surface oxide gold-silver resource outlined in the 2021 PEA. The release also provided an update on brownfield drilling at El Valle-Boinás in Spain.

headline: $1.4B NPV AND 35% IRR FOR QUEBEC RARE EARTH UNDERGROUND — KWYJIBO PROJECT'S FIRST PEA MAKES ECONOMIC CASE IN CHINA EXPORT-CONTROL ERA (TSXV:CLM)
snippet: Consolidated Lithium Metals Inc. (TSXV:CLM) released the Updated Preliminary Economic Assessment for the Kwyjibo Rare Earth Oxide Project in Quebec's Côte-Nord region on July 2, 2026, delivering a US$987 million (C$1.4 billion) after-tax NPV at an 8% discount rate, 35.4% post-tax IRR, and a two-year payback on $881 million of initial development capital. The underground mine is designed to produce approximately 9,800 tonnes of total rare earth oxides (TREO) per year over a 10-year mine life, with a minimal 2.67-hectare surface footprint and processing facilities located offsite; Kwyjibo's resource contains 25% heavy rare earths, giving the project additional strategic value as China's export licensing regime continues to restrict approval rates for European and North American industrial buyers.

headline: META CONTRACTS NUCLEAR FROM VISTRA, TERRAPOWER AND OKLO TO POWER AI SUPERCLUSTER — URANIUM ETF PLAYS AT THREE RISK LEVELS EMERGE
snippet: Meta Platforms has signed agreements with nuclear energy companies Vistra, TerraPower, and Oklo to supply power for its Prometheus AI supercluster under construction in New Albany, Ohio — adding a technology-sector demand layer on top of the existing reactor-build-rate and utility-contracting cycle that drove uranium spot to $101/lb in January 2026. A July 1 analysis identifies three ETF vehicles capturing the nuclear/uranium trade at distinct risk levels: NLR (large-cap utilities, lowest volatility), URA (integrated uranium and nuclear supply chain), and URNM (pure-play uranium miners, highest leverage) — useful context for retail investors considering uranium equity exposure beyond the junior exploration names.

headline: 41 MINING STOCKS AT A MAJOR LOW — ANALYST SAYS EQUITIES WILL OUTPERFORM GOLD AND SILVER IN THE NEXT RALLY
snippet: A GoldSeek technical analyst published a Special Update identifying 41 individual mining stocks presenting what the analysis frames as the best chart setups in months, arguing that the next rally in precious metals will produce stronger returns in well-chosen equities than in gold or silver themselves — as the prior leg was disproportionately driven by physical metal and ETF buying, leaving mining stocks at historically low valuations relative to underlying commodity prices. With gold having corrected from $5,589 to ~$4,100 (a 27% decline from the January peak), the analysis identifies the current zone as a 'major low' that historically precedes multi-month equity recovery phases, with GDX targeting the $130-150 range in the next structural move.

headline: KWYJIBO IS NOT THE ONLY PLAY — OILPRICE.COM NAMES TOP RARE EARTH STOCKS AS CHINA'S EXPORT CONTROLS MAKE WESTERN PROJECTS INVESTABLE
snippet: OilPrice.com's mid-2026 rare earth stock analysis surveys the investable universe of Western rare earth companies as China's export licensing approval rates for European and North American industrial buyers fall below 25% in key sectors, with prices of some restricted elements rising sixfold. The analysis highlights MP Materials (NYSE:MP) — commencing NdFeB magnet sales from its Fort Worth Independence facility in H2 2026 — alongside USA Rare Earth (USAR), Critical Metals Corp (CRML/Tanbreez), and several emerging TSX/TSXV-listed names, framing the sector as newly investable after years of suppressed Western project economics due to Chinese price competition that is now structurally reversing under export controls.
